messages:
maya: Pushed docs PR for airgapped/private VPC installer — adds DNS+proxy guidance for KMS/HSM and a tiny SDK example for mTLS proxy chaining. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 :wave:
sam: Nice. Can you summarize the change for release notes?
maya: Adds section under "Private deployment -> Networking" with: recommended dns entries, /etc/hosts fallback in sealed networks, proxy chaining order for mTLS, and a worked SDK snippet for python requests using client certs.
ashley: Quick ask — can you call out that HSM PKCS#11 uses port 1500 in our installer? we had a customer miss that.
maya: Yep will add port matrix note and a small note about pkcs11 socket vs network. Also flagged calico/nftables edgecase (conntrack) and linked the netpolicy example.
liam: For the SDK snippet, prefer `requests` example + curl one-liner. Also include `VERIFY=false` warning?
maya: I'll add both. current snippet:
```python
import requests
resp = requests.post("https://kms.local/v1/sign", cert=("/etc/ssl/client.crt","/etc/ssl/client.key"), json={"data":"..."}, verify="/etc/ssl/ca.pem")
print(resp.status_code)
```
maya: And curl:
```bash
curl --cert client.pem --key client.key --cacert ca.pem https://kms.local/v1/sign -d '{"data":"..."}'
```
sam: tiny nit: use kms.internal rather than kms.local per naming conventions.
maya: done in next push.
devops-bot: CI: docs lint passed for PR 1234
ashley: Also add a short troubleshooting section: "If KMS can't be reached in sealed net, check NodePort mapping and kube-proxy mode" — we've seen that.
maya: Added troubleshooting + a link to the onprem net debug script.
liam: Who's taking the final review? I can do tech review tomorrow AM.
maya: Thanks — assigning to @liam. Also requesting review from @ashley for HSM notes.
ashley: ack. I'll skim for PKCS11 phrasing.
sam: Can we also add a one-line migration note: "If migrating from hosted KMS to private HSM, export key wrapping metadata and rotate after import"?
maya: Good call. Added migration warning and a sample key-wrap command snippet.
liam: LGTM on the examples. Just suggest moving SDK snippet into a subfolder so it's easier to copy.
maya: Moved it and updated internal links. Will squash and request merge once ashley's done.
ashley: minor wording nit on pkcs11 path, otherwise approve.
maya: merging after CI green. thx all :tada: 
devops-bot: CI: docs build and linkcheck found 1 broken link -> https://old.example.com/hsm-guide
maya: Fixed link to https://docs.redwood.com/onprem/hsm-quickstart and pushed.
devops-bot: CI: all checks passed. PR 1234 merged by maya.
